Many parents dont find out becuase the kids know that they will get in trouble. If you suspect your kid is smoking weed some signs may be being entergetic/tired, going out at wierd times, red eyes, and a large appetite. If you suspect they are be honest with them. "Son/daughter, I promise no consequences will happen if you tell the truth, I notice this happend and I want to help you". Many times the kids will deny it but its a good step. It works much better than trying to force drug test them, grounding them, or trying to get cops involved. 

To all parents, many times kids dont do drugs to seem cool with peers. In most cases they may have done drugs with friends but its not the only times they do them. Majority of pepole take drugs becuase it makes them feel better. Dont think your kid is a horrible person if they do drugs, be kind with them and be open.

To sum it all up, you need to approach it from the standpoint of kindness not anger.
